 HoopsHype Oct. 19, 2026, 3:54 p.m. ET Kevin Gray Jr.: Mavericks star Kyrie Irving when I asked him about the plan for him playing games this season coming off the long layoff said: “We’re approaching day by day and game by game, and I think that’s the best case scenario for me.” #MFFL
